--- text
foo| bar
--- keys
Type(X) Cmd+Z Cmd+Shift+Z
--- expect
fooX| bar
--- note
Type / undo / redo must round-trip to the exact state that existed right after
the edit. Typing X gives "fooX bar" with the caret after the X (column 4).
Undo removes it; redo re-applies that same insertion and places the caret back
where the edit left it, after the X. Redo reinstates a change together with the
selection that change produced, so it is not a second undo: landing the caret
at the pre-edit column 3 would be wrong. The document and caret after redo have
to match the state immediately after the original Type.
